why: Latin W is a source typo for ष in आप्त.पुरुष.अधिष्ठितः.
Latin A in लवन्Aम् is a source typo; the word is लवणम् (salt), giving पञ्च.पलिकं मुख.लवणम्.
The Latin letters are inside the editors' own doubt mark '(तज्.ज्ञातेभ्यः? cf. N12.60)', a cross-reference, not a typing error.
Causative कारयेत् is needed by sense and the pada has only 7 aksharas with करयेत्.
तारयेत् 'should have the waters crossed' is correct with उदकानि.
The string is अश्वायाम-चतुरश्र 'a horse-length square'; only the e-text's split is odd, matching the previous line's अश्वायाम् अद्वि.गुण.
चतुर्भिर् is the regular instrumental, parallel to त्रिभिश्.
प्रभवति 'prevails' fits the sense.
पूरयेत् 'should fill' is right for filling the gap with the leftover earth.

suggest: "प्रकृति.राज.विवादयोः प्रकृति.विवादः प्रकृतीनां भेदकः पर.अभियोगान् आवहति, राज.विवादस् तु प्रकृतीनां द्वि.गुण.भक्त.वेतन.परिहार.करो भवति" इत्य् आचार्याः ।
why: प्रकृइति has an extra इ; the word is प्रकृति as in the same line.
अपरस्य 'of the later one' is the intended contrast with पूर्वस्य.
अनर्थम् contrasts with अर्थं in the same sentence.
ध्मापयेत् 'should have it blown/smelted' is the metallurgical term.

suggest: द्वारादेयं शुल्कं पञ्च.भागः आनुग्राहिकं वा यथा.देश.उपकारं स्थापयेत् ।
why: स्थापय्तेत् has a misplaced virama/extra त; the verb is स्थापयेत्.
गोपयेत् 'should guard' the strī-dhana is correct.
कोपयेत् 'should make angry' is confirmed by कुपितैस् in the next line.
अन्तर्.लेपयेत् 'smear inside' the pot is correct.

suggest: राज.आज्ञया पुरुषम् अनभिगच्छन्ती गणिका शिफा.सहस्रं लभेत, पञ्च.सहस्रं वा दण्डः ।
why: लभेएत has a doubled vowel; the optative is लभेत.
छादित.व्यसनेन is a regular instrumental and the pada scans 8.
विघातयेत् 'should frustrate' is correct with बल.समुद्दानं.
अहिरण्य is fine, but पाषढाः is a broken conjunct for पाषण्डाः (cf. पाषण्डच्.छद्मभिर् elsewhere).
सहिरण्य 'together with money' is a regular compound.
विकुर्वीत 'would turn hostile' fits अवमानितं.
तोषयेत् 'should satisfy' the helper is correct.
व्यसनिनम् 'one in calamity' is a regular accusative.
त्रासनम् 'terrifying' also appears in the elephant list before.
विकरोति 'alters the mind' is correct.
वापयेत् 'should have sown' is the right verb for ploughed land.
निवेषयेत् has ष for श; the next line has निवेशयेत्.
बल.अबलम् 'strength and weakness' is a regular dvandva and scans 8.
बहुलम् 'the greater part' fits the sense.
A name in a mantra list (घट.उबलम्); names are not changed and the pada scans 8.
न प्रभवन्ति 'have no power' is correct.
दुर्गस्थम् 'one in a fort' is a regular form.
पातयेत् 'should let fall' a wall or stone is correct.
व्याधितम् 'sick' is a listed army calamity.
व्याख्यानम् is one of the thirty-two tantrayuktis.
आगच्छेत् 'should come' to see is correct.
वेतनेन is a regular instrumental; the ' १२ ' and colophon are the edition's own.
मोषयेत् 'should have him robbed' is correct.
दूषयेत् 'should spoil' the treaty is correct.
राज.व्यञ्जनम् 'one disguised as the king' is correct.
संस्थानम् is also used in the following line.
सान्त्वयेत् 'should console' is correct and the pada scans 8.
कारयेन् is the sandhi of कारयेत् before नवमे.
पुरुषश् is the sandhi of पुरुषः before चेन्.
अमित्रयोः is a regular dual genitive.
नित्य.अमित्रया is a regular instrumental agreeing with भूम्या.
प्रकृतिश् is the sandhi of प्रकृतिः before च.
प्रकृतिभिः is a regular instrumental plural.
प्रकृतिभ्यां is a regular dual instrumental.
प्रकृतिच्.छिद्राणि is the edition's sandhi of प्रकृति-छिद्राणि.
विंशतिकं 'worth twenty' is a regular derivative.
विंशतिश् is the sandhi of विंशतिः before च.
स्थापयेच् is correct sandhi, but शुक्लम् is a metathesis of शुल्कम् 'toll', the topic of this chapter (cf. 02.22.8).
व्यसनतो is the regular ablative in -तस्.
व्यसनस्य is a regular genitive.
व्यसनजो is the sandhi of व्यसनजः before लाभः.
अटवीश् is the sandhi of अटवीः before च.
